traits.name: Great Weapon Fighting
traits.text:
When the champion rolls a
1 or 2 on a damage die for an attack with a melee
weapon, it can reroll the die and must use the new
roll.

traits.name: Improved Critical
traits.text:
The champion's weapon attacks
score a critical hit on a result of 19 or 20.

actions.name: Glaive
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10
ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Action Surge (1/Short Rest)
actions.text:
The champion makes
two glaive attacks.
